description: This Java source file defines the 'StreamingAck' class, which is responsible for representing acknowledgment messages related to subscription actions (subscribe/unsubscribe) for streaming types in a gateway streaming service. It provides methods to construct instances from JSON, serialize back to JSON, and override methods for equality, hashing, and string representation.

classes.name: StreamingAck
classes.description: Represents an acknowledgment message indicating whether a subscription for a specific 'StreamingType' was successfully added or removed in a gateway streaming context.

methods.name: StreamingAck
methods.description: Constructor to create a new StreamingAck instance indicating subscription or unsubscription.

methods.name: getStreamingType
methods.description: Returns the StreamingType associated with this acknowledgment.

methods.name: isSubscribed
methods.description: Returns whether the acknowledgment indicates a subscription was added (true) or removed (false).

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Static method to create a StreamingAck instance from a JSON object.

methods.name: toJson
methods.description: Serializes this StreamingAck instance into a JSON object, considering schema version and predicate.
